Unknown: Scar managed to deactivate Strelok's protection! And fortune has favored us-the mercenary has captured the stalker! But the Emission is still approaching! Why?!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [StoryEvents.Event-End-3].Desc-NonOwner
Unknown: We received word that the mercenary Scar managed to disable Strelok's protection and capture him. There was quite a firefight at CNPP. Preliminary reports from Clear Sky contacts suggested this event would halt the Emissions, but it seems those were merely rumors. A powerful Emission wave is imminent.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: ScenarioName
Unknown: Story. Clear Sky

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: ScenarioDescription
Unknown: This scenario recreates the plot of the original game. Scar's attempt to stop Strelok. This scenario has a turn limit. You must capture the entire Zone before Strelok reaches the C-Consciousness. There are two endings. The first is the canonical ending, the second is a secret ending for the Clear Sky faction if they successfully advance to CNPP. Diplomacy between factions is close to canon.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: ScenarioLoseDescription
Unknown: Defeat conditions: lose all controlled territories or fail to meet victory conditions within approximately 140 turns.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].Name
Unknown: Bandits

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].Description
Unknown: Bandits - the criminal element of the Zone. They control significant territories closer to the southern parts of the Zone. Despite their favorable position, defense won't be easy, as they are in conflict with almost everyone. They lack proper weaponry and a substantial number of capable fighters. The faction needs reorganization, both in internal affairs and external relations.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-War
Unknown: Well, sucker, had your fun? Time to face the music! The boys are comin' for ya!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Unknown: Hey-hey! Bro, chill out, yeah? Time to stop shootin' at each other, capiche?

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Unknown: Hey, Bro, how 'bout we team up, yeah? Y'know... shoot some guys together... and all that. Whaddya say? Deal?

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-BreakAlliance
Unknown: Nah, man, you're a real sucker, a total loser. From now on, everyone's on their own!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
Unknown: Hey, listen up, pal, got any spare change, yeah? We could use about this much:

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
Unknown: Who do you think you're messin' with, tough guy? You're dead meat, ya hear?!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
Unknown: Well, that's just... wow, man...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Unknown: We'll find some - and cut it into strips!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Unknown: Listen, we won't touch ya, word is bond, for real!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Unknown: Nah, nah, that's totally not it, you're bluffing!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-Yes
Unknown: Hang tight, bro, everything's gonna be smooth real soon...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Unknown: Did you hit your head or somethin'? Where would we get that kind of cash! We could use some ourselves...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes
Unknown: Bro, here's the dough!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-No
Unknown: Bro, that was really uncalled for! Shouldn't have done that...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-Yes
Unknown: Hey, bro, that's what I'm talkin' about! Good job...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-No
Unknown: Bro, that was really uncalled for! Shouldn't have done that...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-Yes
Unknown: Oh, bro, excellent! Now we'll be shootin' suckers together!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].Text-End-Step-Victory
Unknown: You survived! Victory!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Victory
Unknown: Victory by event flag!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Unknown: The faction has been completely wiped out. Now other factions will divide the Zone among themselves. Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].Text-End-Step-Lose
Unknown: Time's up. You failed to gain control over the Zone. Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
Unknown: Time's up. You failed to gain control over the Zone. Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Anarchy].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the faction behaved less and less like what it originally was. Yes, crime remained, but there was less of it. The leadership tried to promote ideas close to what the "Freedom" faction preached, but the rank-and-file were in no hurry to embrace these new ideals, as the old ways of robbery and looting seemed simpler and more understandable. The faction was fracturing before everyone's eyes. Each new day brought fresh disobedience from separate groups. A new conflict in the Zone was imminent...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.AntiZone].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the faction behaved less and less like what it originally was. Crime decreased significantly. The leadership increasingly pushed the theme of fighting the Zone. Yes, many understood that there was no one left to rob - everyone around was "one of us" - and in principle agreed, but since there were genuine criminals in the faction, separate groups emerged that robbed those very "own people". Local skirmishes flared up everywhere. The Zone was once again a step away from a large-scale war of all against all...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Control].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the faction behaved less and less like what it originally was. Crime decreased significantly. A strict hierarchy was introduced. The situation was most accurately described by the name "Penal Battalion". Rumors circulated among faction members that the leadership had bent to government forces. Many accepted this fact, but there were also those "bosses" and "kingpins" who disagreed with such order. A new large-scale conflict was brewing, but this time within the faction itself...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Crime].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! The Zone turned into a criminal quasi-state. The Zone began to live "by the code". Soon there was no one left to rob, and the faction sank into feuds. Instead of shooting monsters and collecting artifacts, Bandits shot at each other...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Crime].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Unknown: The last Bandit caught a bullet. There is no more place for the criminal world in the Zone... Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Crime].Text-End-Step-Lose
Unknown: Time's up. The boys say you're no «boss» at all... Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Crime].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
Unknown: Time's up. The boys say you're no «boss» at all... Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Exploring].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! The faction controls the entire territory. There is no one left to rob. Soon there will be nowhere to loot either... The leadership is already actively switching to profitable contracts from the government. Groups of Scientists taking measurements of anomalous activity under the watchful guard of local "brothers" can now often be seen in the Zone. Yesterday's Bandits now walked around doing the very thing they once considered too dirty for themselves - searching for artifacts, harvesting mutant body parts, taking strange measurements with equally strange devices. Not everyone liked this, so separate groups of people emerged who organized attacks on "their own". They tried to fight them actively, but more and more of these «dissenters» appeared, as not many found their place in the new reality of working to study the Zone...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! The Zone turned into a criminal quasi-state. The Zone began to live "by the code". Soon there was no one left to rob, and the faction sank into feuds. Instead of shooting monsters and collecting artifacts, Bandits shot at each other...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Unknown: The last Bandit caught a bullet. There is no more place for the criminal world in the Zone... Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Growth].Text-End-Step-Lose
Unknown: Time's up. The boys say you're no «boss» at all... Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Growth].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
Unknown: Time's up. The boys say you're no «boss» at all... Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Mercenary].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! The faction controls the entire territory. There is no one left to rob. Soon there will be nowhere to loot either... The leadership is already actively switching to profitable contracts from the outside world. But the emphasis was placed on more criminal contracts, so Scientists in the Zone guarded by local fighters were practically never seen, which significantly limited the study of the Zone. The government planned to undertake several military operations to regain control over key Zone facilities. Soon there will be a «War in Zone» again...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Sectarianism].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! But despite the faction occupying all territories, there was no real control over the forces. Confusion reigned everywhere. Strange speeches from the leadership, strange behavior of everyone in the northern Zone, the recently reactivated psi-installations... All this worried those in the south. The south began to arm itself and form its own hierarchy with commanders. A new stage of the «War in Zone» was about to begin...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Stability].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! The faction controls the entire territory. There is no one left to rob. Soon there will be nowhere to loot either... The leadership actively tries to find new ways to enrich themselves. Fighters began to be divided into subgroups. Some for artifact hunting, some for hunting mutant body parts, others used as mercenaries for external contracts. But there were also those for whom none of this "peaceful" craft suited. Soon the first conflicts began, followed by fights. The faction's internal hierarchy was in turmoil, and it was unknown how it would all end...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Stalkers].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the faction behaved less and less like what it originally was. Crime truly decreased. Pay your share - and you can walk around and collect artifacts. No one should interfere. And if someone does, those guys will be found. Quickly. But if they have patrons in the leadership, they'll just be let off with a verbal warning. So soon separate groups with their own leaders formed within the faction, pulling it toward an armed internal conflict...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Unknow].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! The Zone turned into a criminal quasi-state. The Zone began to live "by the code". Soon there was no one left to rob, and the faction sank into feuds. Instead of shooting monsters and collecting artifacts, Bandits shot at each other...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Unknow].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Unknown: The last Bandit caught a bullet. There is no more place for the criminal world in the Zone... Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Unknow].Text-End-Step-Lose
Unknown: Time's up. The boys say you're no «boss» at all... Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Unknow].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
Unknown: Time's up. The boys say you're no «boss» at all... Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.bandits.Zombie].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Now the C-Consciousness is safe. Soon psi-emission covered the entire Zone thanks to an increased number of emitters. Even the Cordon became dangerous. Although the government did not let mutants out of the Zone, it no longer tried to reclaim it...

Unknown: Duty

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Description
Unknown: Duty - the faction's goal is to protect the world from the contamination of the Zone. A fairly powerful militarized faction. A favorable position, good weaponry, and a predisposition to fighting mutants guarantee success in capable hands.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-War
Unknown: You and your gang are a threat to the world. Time to deal with you!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Unknown: We want to establish a ceasefire with you. Do you agree?

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Unknown: We propose an alliance. Together we could carry out a couple of operations against our enemies. Do you agree?

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-BreakAlliance
Unknown: We will no longer cooperate!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
Unknown: Got any spare funds? Times are tough for us. We could use about this much:

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
Unknown: Understood. We'll cleanse the Zone of you too!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
Unknown: Pity... but if you insist, so be it.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Unknown: No, we definitely won't go for that right now.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Unknown: We hope for further cooperation.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Unknown: No, we definitely won't go for that right now.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-Yes
Unknown: Ri-i-ight, excellent, we have a deal!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Unknown: No, we cannot help at the moment.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes
Unknown: Very well, we will help you.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-No
Unknown: Oh, what a shame you refused!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-Yes
Unknown: Good, that's encouraging!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-No
Unknown: Oh, what a shame you refused!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-Yes
Unknown: Good, that's encouraging!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Text-End-Step-Victory
Unknown: You survived! Victory!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Victory
Unknown: Victory by event flag!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Unknown: The faction has been completely wiped out. Now other factions will divide the Zone among themselves. Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Text-End-Step-Lose
Unknown: Time's up. You failed to gain control over the Zone. Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.:main].Text-End-EventFlag-Lose
Unknown: Time's up. You failed to gain control over the Zone. Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Anarchy].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! It would seem the war is finally over. The Zone is controlled by a single faction. But not long ago, its ideology changed. And to one that its founders had opposed. Even before the war ended, disagreements were brewing among commanders. It seems a new «War in Zone» is approaching, and this one will be purely ideological...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.AntiZone].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon Duty established contact with the government and began cooperating with them. Mutants were eradicated, Scientists were dispatched to the Zone more frequently. Duty members increasingly noticed secret service agents among their ranks, but perhaps those were just rumors...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.AntiZone].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Unknown: Your faction has been completely destroyed. The last Duty members scattered in all directions, lacking the will to fight for Duty's ideals. Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Control].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the leadership established contact with the government and began openly cooperating with them. Not everyone approved. Some stalkers broke away from the main group and formed their own factions in different parts of the Zone. A new «War in Zone» for control over everything inside the perimeter is brewing.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Crime].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! It would seem that order has finally come to the Zone. But that might only appear so from the outside. The faction's leadership is now in the hands of criminal elements. Everything is gradually sliding into ordinary racketeering, looting, and "protection". New conflicts are brewing. The faction certainly won't be able to remain a unified whole...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Exploring].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the leadership established contact with the government and made some concessions to avoid conflict with the outside world. Faction members generally supported this direction, as it is much easier to fight an enemy you have studied well. Stalkers in the field already felt the first results of cooperation: excellent artifact detection devices, more accurate instruments for marking anomalous locations, vulnerable spots on mutants. This allowed faction members to overlook the fact that documents from laboratories were handed over to the government, and everyone who knew their contents somehow suddenly disappeared. Allegedly, they "lost interest in the Zone and decided to return home". And to this day, anyone who finds any documents in the Zone's underground disappears...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon Duty established contact with the government and began cooperating with them. Mutants were eradicated, Scientists were dispatched to the Zone more frequently. Duty members increasingly noticed secret service agents among their ranks, but perhaps those were just rumors...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Unknown: Your faction has been completely destroyed. The last Duty members scattered in all directions, lacking the will to fight for Duty's ideals. Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Mercenary].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Now the Zone is controlled by a single faction. But not long ago, its priorities changed. For some reason, mutants are no longer being actively exterminated. Everyone talks about money and how to earn it easier... Organize "safaris for the rich from the outside world"? Or catch a mutant for sale? Maybe smuggle a rare artifact across the perimeter into someone's private collection? This approach to the Zone didn't sit well with everyone. Within the faction's ranks, there were those who still remembered what true Duty once was. They gradually separated from the main mass and occupied key points inside the perimeter. Rumor has it they are being helped by the Military. It is highly likely the Zone awaits new clashes with many casualties...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Sectarianism].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! It would seem the war is finally over. The Zone is controlled by a single faction. But not long ago, its priorities changed. For some reason, mutants are no longer being actively exterminated. Everyone talks about certain patrons from the north. Documents from laboratories disappear in unknown directions. Among ordinary fighters, resentment is growing due to the strange religious speeches of their commanders. Not everyone is ready to have their brains washed by some incomprehensible sermons. Especially those in the southern Zone. New contacts with the Military have already been established. And recent news about the activation of psi-installations in the north made it clear - there is no turning back. Inside the perimeter, a new «War in Zone» is about to begin...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Stability].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the faction established contact with the government and began cooperating with them. Progress was slow, despite pressure from the outside world. Mutants were still being eradicated, artifacts were still being sought, Scientists were still being guarded. But everything was somehow unhurried. Some got the impression that the leadership was in no hurry to fight the manifestations of the Zone. Certain individuals claimed that the leadership was dragging its feet because they were trying to enrich themselves as much as possible
column3: others said that faction leaders didn't want to lose the power they held. There was practically no discontent among rank-and-file fighters, as no one was shortchanged in terms of earnings, but ideologically charged commanders began preparing a coup...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Stalkers].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the faction's leadership increasingly shifted the focus of its propaganda. Artifact hunting, cooperation with the government and Scientists became routine. There were no Bandits left in the Zone, and any racketeering was nipped in the bud, so earning money in the Zone became somewhat easier. But although the government didn't particularly conflict with the faction's leadership, it was preparing plans to take the Zone under its control...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Unknow].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon Duty established contact with the government and began cooperating with them. Mutants were eradicated, Scientists were dispatched to the Zone more frequently. Duty members increasingly noticed secret service agents among their ranks, but perhaps those were just rumors...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Unknow].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Unknown: Your faction has been completely destroyed. The last Duty members scattered in all directions, lacking the will to fight for Duty's ideals. Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.Duty.Zombie].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Now the C-Consciousness is safe. Soon psi-emission covered the entire Zone thanks to an increased number of emitters. Even the Cordon became dangerous. Although the government did not let mutants out of the Zone, it no longer tried to reclaim it...

Unknown: Freedom

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].Description
Unknown: Freedom - an anarchist faction that is hostile to government troops and research groups. A favorable position, experienced fighters who are also well-armed... Almost the perfect recipe for a successful faction in capable hands.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-War
Unknown: Alright, man, get ready! We're comin' for you and your crew.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral
Unknown: Dude, maybe we can call it a day, huh?

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance
Unknown: Hey man, how about an alliance? Whaddya think?

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-BreakAlliance
Unknown: Sorry, dude, but our paths diverge.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
Unknown: Hey, man! Freedom's runnin' low on free cash... Could you spare us an amount like this:

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
Unknown: Looks like coffins are gonna get expensive!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
Unknown: O-o-oh... Got it, man, whatever.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Unknown: Nah, we're not down with that.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Unknown: Okay, we're cool!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Unknown: Nah, dude, we're passin' on this one.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-Yes
Unknown: O-o-oh, sweet, it's a deal!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Unknown: Man, nah, what? We ain't ready to drop that kinda cash right now...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes
Unknown: Dude, no problem! Already sent!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-No
Unknown: Man, that's bad news...

Unknown: Victory! Soon the Zone was declared a free quasi-state. The head of the SBU went gray from the news published in the media. Secret documents found by the Freedom faction in Zone laboratories became available to the public. Now the whole world knows what was happening in the Zone and how it appeared!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.Anarchy].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Unknown: Your faction has been completely destroyed. The last Freedom members scattered in all directions, lacking the will to fight for Freedom's ideals. Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.AntiZone].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! It would seem the war is finally over. The Zone is controlled by a single faction. But not long ago, its ideology changed. And to one that its founders had opposed. Even before the war ended, disagreements were brewing among commanders. It seems a new «War in Zone» is approaching, and this one will be purely ideological...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.Control].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Despite capturing all territories, the situation did not stabilize. Many fighters were dissatisfied with the current order. Rumors circulate that government forces are working among the leadership, as the transfer of certain key territories and CNPP itself under Military control was announced. Commanders have already emerged who refuse to obey orders from the top and are forming a unified resistance network. It seems a new stage of the «War in Zone» is coming...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.Crime].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the Zone was declared a free quasi-state. But the recent shift in the faction's focus toward crime led to new chaos in the Zone. Within a week, a struggle for power and spheres of influence began. This led to new mass battles across the entire Exclusion Zone. The Military have already prepared plans to seize key locations, and assaults are about to begin. A new «War in Zone» is already starting...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.Exploring].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the leadership established contact with the government and made some concessions to avoid conflict with the outside world. Faction members generally supported this direction, as it is much easier to fight an enemy you have studied well. Stalkers in the field already felt the first results of cooperation: excellent artifact detection devices, more accurate instruments for marking anomalous locations, vulnerable spots on mutants. This allowed faction members to overlook the fact that documents from laboratories were handed over to the government, and everyone who knew their contents somehow suddenly disappeared. Allegedly, they "lost interest in the Zone and decided to return home". And to this day, anyone who finds any documents in the Zone's underground disappears...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Victory

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Lose

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.Mercenary].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Now the Zone is controlled by a single faction. But not long ago, its priorities changed. Everyone talks about money and how to earn it easier... Organize "safaris for the rich from the outside world"? Or catch a mutant for sale? Maybe smuggle a rare artifact across the perimeter into someone's private collection? This approach to the Zone didn't sit well with everyone. Within the faction's ranks, there were those who still remembered what true Freedom once was. They gradually separated from the main mass and occupied key points inside the perimeter. It is highly likely the Zone awaits new clashes with many casualties...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.Sectarianism].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! It would seem the war is finally over. The Zone is controlled by a single faction. But not long ago, its priorities changed. Everyone talks about certain patrons from the north. Documents from laboratories disappear in unknown directions. Among ordinary fighters, resentment is growing due to the strange religious speeches of their commanders. Not everyone is ready to have their brains washed by some incomprehensible sermons. Especially those in the southern Zone. And recent news about the activation of psi-installations in the north made it clear - there is no turning back. Inside the perimeter, a new «War in Zone» is about to begin...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.Stability].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the faction began leaking information about the Zone to the media. But this opening of the Zone to the world proceeded extremely slowly and unhurriedly. Some got the impression that the leadership was in no hurry to fight the government. Certain individuals claimed that the leadership was dragging its feet because they were trying to enrich themselves as much as possible
column3: others said that faction leaders didn't want to lose the power they held
column4: still others claimed that the leader had bent to the government... There was practically no discontent among rank-and-file fighters, as no one was shortchanged in terms of earnings, but ideologically charged commanders began preparing a coup...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.freedom.Stalkers].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the Zone was declared a free quasi-state. But unlike Freedom's original goals of revealing the Zone's secrets, the current goals after the recent shift in priorities somehow bypassed those secrets. Not entirely. A few scandals after publication in the media guaranteed trouble for the government. After that, the government increased pressure on the faction's leadership, which led to a split. The once-unified faction fractured into dozens of smaller ones. However, this did not lead to a new war, only to numerous minor conflicts. The Military, deciding this was their chance, began preparing for a new operation to seize key locations in the Zone. Can the fragmented faction defend the territory? Unknown...

Unknown: Locate and eradicate! *Interlocutor has blacklisted you*

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
Unknown: The Monolith would never approve of this! *Interlocutor removed you from friends*

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Unknown: You shall know the wrath of the Monolith! *Interlocutor exited the chat*

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Unknown: And the day shall come when the Monolith shines once more in all its glory! *Interlocutor exited the chat*

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-Yes

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.monolith.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No
Unknown: The Monolith commands no mercy for the faithless! *Interlocutor removed you from chat*

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.scientists.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.scientists.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.scientists.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-Yes
Unknown: Agreed.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.scientists.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.scientists.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-Yes
Unknown: Greetings! Yes, we have processed the transfer for the specified amount.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.scientists.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-No

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.scientists.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Neutral-Yes

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.scientists.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-No

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.scientists.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-Alliance-Yes
Unknown: Excellent, my friend! We are glad you agreed.

However, their territories are scattered across locations, making them difficult to hold. The faction must define its developmental priorities.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Question-BreakAlliance
Unknown: We are terminating the alliance!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ask
Unknown: We've hit some financial difficulties. Could use some help. We're looking for a sum like this:

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-0-Down
Unknown: You backstabbing rat! War it is, then!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Down
Unknown: So be it.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-No
Unknown: We see no necessity for that at the moment.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-1-Yes
Unknown: Yes, we agree to a ceasefire.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-No
Unknown: We are not sure this is needed right now.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-Ans-2-Yes
Unknown: Yes, we agree to cooperate.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.:main].DiplomacyText-RequestMoney-Ans-No

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Anarchy].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon, a unified stalker faction drafted a set of rules resembling those of Freedom, but with clear differences. The focus shifted to money rather than ideology. Over time, "splinter" groups formed based on "interests", leading to a rift in leadership. Many spoke of an impending new stage of the «War in Zone»...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.AntiZone].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon, a unified stalker faction drafted rules similar to Duty's, but without the military slant. Not everyone approved, but dissenters stayed quiet, as the new leadership actively fought all Zone threats, making artifact hunting safer and eliminating bandit worries. Mutant hunting was streamlined, so even blind dogs were rarely seen in the south. Faction command actively cooperated with Scientists and avoided clashing with the Military, leading to a new era of Zone exploration, though its secrets were reluctantly shared with the public.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Control].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon stalkers established rules to bring order to the Zone. Even military ranks replaced stalker ranks. Not a trace of the old command chaos remained. A strict chain of command was established. Newcomers were forcibly integrated into this hierarchy, while dissenters were immediately handed over to the Military beyond the Cordon without question. Rumors suggested military brass sat in faction leadership, but no one could prove it. Or perhaps they didn't live long enough to publish proof, as the Military took them to unknown locations. The Zone became less open, but safer, especially for government organizations.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Crime].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon stalkers enforced a rule: only one faction in the Zone, and everyone must pay a share. Traders were taxed. Those who couldn't pay were handed to the Military beyond the Cordon. The Zone became less open to government study, and the criminalized order reduced the influx of newcomers to stalkers-guarded territories.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Exploring].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the free stalker faction actively collaborated with all scientists in the Zone. Harvesting mutant parts, artifacts, measuring anomalous activity... Everyone made a living this way. A real hunt began for documents from underground labs. Finding them was one thing... getting them to the nearest scientist bunker was another. The fact that bunkers multiplied didn't help. Bounty hunters became the new scourge of the Zone. If anyone learned a stalker had even one lab document or a valuable scientific item... they were as good as dead. They wouldn't reach any bunker. People in the Zone split into two: those who harvest and those who hunt the harvesters. Gunfire echoed everywhere. Gradually, the Zone grew more and more dangerous...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon free stalkers established a rule: no more factions in the Zone, and anyone turning to banditry was handed to the Military beyond the Cordon. The Zone became open to study for all willing. And less dangerous.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Growth].Text-End-Standart-Lose
Unknown: Loners have been completely wiped out. Now only factions will divide the Zone. No free stalkers remain! Defeat!

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Mercenary].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the free stalker faction increasingly resembled ordinary mercenaries. The strict hierarchy collapsed, the faction fractured. "Contracts" dictated the new order. Assassinations became so frequent that the Zone filled with "professional hitmen". But while people tore each other apart for money, the Zone grew far more dangerous, as mutants received far less attention than they should. Rumors said new, previously unknown, and extremely dangerous monsters were already spotted near the Cordon.

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Sectarianism].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the free stalker faction increasingly resembled a cult. "Lower ranks" whispered that "leadership" was under the influence of "certain forces from the north". Commanders' speeches grew increasingly religious. Active combat against government forces expanded to push influence beyond the perimeter. Brainwashing intensified daily, but some resisted and protected their minds. Most were in the south, outside the range of the reactivated psi-installations. A new stage of the «War in Zone» was brewing...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Stability].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon the free stalker faction, lacking external enemies, turned inward. Intrigue, scandals, executions... That's what the faction became. Tasks devolved to guarding and clearing main Zone routes, while remote areas were neglected. This led to a surge in mutants and those fleeing the internal infighting. The faction cooperated with Scientists and the Military, but reluctantly, prompting government forces to consider building a new base inside the perimeter, which could spark new clashes within the Zone...

[Advisors.Advisor-Mutants-1].Name: [Groups.stalkers.Stalkers].Text-End-Standart-Victory
Unknown: Victory! Soon free stalkers established a rule: no more factions in the Zone, and anyone turning to banditry was handed to the Military beyond the Cordon. The Zone became open to study for all willing. And less dangerous.
